summary: Iteration 11. The Gold yearly plan, promoter Event Spotlight and the Venue Earnings dashboard all work end to end. Backend: the new test file test_nocturne_iter11.py passed 21/21. The full suite, run serially with -n 0, passed 164/164 and covers the regression checks for monthly membership, boost, ticket and reservation checkouts. E2E at 390px with Stripe test card 4242: guest Membership -> Gold -> gold-billing-toggle appears (only for Gold) -> gold-yearly -> button 'Subscribe · $1,490/year' -> Stripe shows 'Nocturne Gold membership (yearly) $1,490.00 per year' -> payment-status-paid. GET /membership/subscription then returns active, level gold, interval 'year', renews_at +1 year. Stripe line item: recurring.interval=year, unit_amount 149000. Promoter: event detail shows spotlight-card, spotlight-3days goes to Stripe ($39.00) -> paid. GET /api/events lists that event first with spotlight=true. The home feed shows the SPOTLIGHT badge (event-spotlight-{id}) and the card switches to 'Spotlighted — extend it'. Guest sees no spotlight-card. API checks: guest and venue_owner get 403; past event, bad plan, and yearly Silver/Bronze get 400; unknown event 404; bad interval 422. A second spotlight extends from the current end (+7d). Venue: Host Studio earnings-card shows the $0 empty state, and with 3 TEST_ payables it shows owed $290.50 / paid $100.00, the per-source breakdown and the recent list. /host/earnings for guest and promoter returns 403 and for admin 200; its totals match /host/payouts. 4 UI copy/state bugs were found on the Membership screen when the plan is yearly. No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues detected.

minor.issue: A user on an active Gold yearly plan can check out Gold monthly (200). activate_subscription then replaces the yearly plan right away, with no proration or credit for the unused year. In proxy mode the old-sub cancel also fails (known since iteration 10), so both subs stay live in Stripe. Consider blocking a yearly->monthly switch until the period ends, or prorating.
Any promoter can spotlight any event, including events they don't promote. Confirm this is intended. There is also no cap on how many events can be spotlighted at once.
DRY: /host/earnings is a superset of /host/payouts (same aggregation). Consider removing /host/payouts or making it reuse the new aggregation.

ui_bugs.issue: The title is hardcoded to 'monthly', so a yearly Gold plan shows 'Gold · monthly'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/membership.tsx:91
renewDate has no year. A yearly plan bought on Nov 14 shows 'Renews automatically on Nov 14 (yearly).', which reads like today. Add the year. Reference: /app/frontend/app/membership.tsx:69

The 'yearly' state always starts false. A user already on Gold yearly who taps Gold sees 'Subscribe · $149/month' instead of 'Your current plan', which invites an accidental switch to monthly. Initialise it from sub.interval === 'year'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/membership.tsx:28
The hint always says 'renews monthly', even when Gold yearly is selected. Reference: /app/frontend/app/membership.tsx:173

issues: The amount is rendered with toFixed(2) and no thousands separator: 'Nocturne Gold · $1,490/year · $1490.00'. Use toLocaleString.
SpotlightCard also renders on past events (the backend returns 400 'already happened' only after the tap). Hide it when the event date has passed.
There is no label between the per-source totals and the recent rows. Paid rows are told apart only by green colour, with no 'Paid' text. The card has no loading or error state and returns null.

action_items: membership.tsx:28: initialise `yearly` from sub.interval (useEffect when sub loads).
membership.tsx:69/173: include the year in renewDate, and make the hint interval-aware ('renews yearly').
payment-result.tsx:88: format the amount with thousands separators.
Decide the rule for Gold yearly -> monthly switches (block until period end, or prorate). Today the switch goes through and drops the unused year.
Optional: hide SpotlightCard for past events, and confirm whether promoters may spotlight events they don't promote.
critical_code_review_comments: subscription_params: the trial correctly applies only when interval == 'month'. Yearly uses YEARLY_PRICE with recurring.interval='year' (verified on the Stripe session).
The duplicate-plan check compares level + interval + status, so Gold yearly -> Gold yearly is 400 and Gold yearly -> Gold monthly is allowed (see the backend minor issue).
apply_spotlight stacks from max(current end, now). Verified a +7d extension. GET /events sorts spotlight first, then featured.
host_earnings correctly scopes by owner_id (admin sees all) and excludes _id. The SOURCE keys (ticket, table, reservation) match the record_venue_share callers.

success_rate.frontend: ~85%: all 3 features work E2E; 4 copy/state bugs on the Membership screen for yearly plans

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the backend suite with -n 0. A full run takes ~2.5 min, so launch it with setsid nohup ... & and poll; a plain background job is killed when the tool times out. conftest.simulate_paid works for one-time kinds (spotlight/boost) but not for subscriptions, which need a real 4242 payment in the browser. The proxy supports Session.retrieve(expand=['line_items']) but returns 404 for list_line_items. Stripe pay button names: 'Subscribe' (subscription) and 'Pay' (one-time). Login on web: clear localStorage, then /sign-in with signin-email, signin-password and signin-submit.
rca_of_issue: The Membership screen was written for monthly plans only: the title literal 'monthly' (line 91), the hint text (line 173), and a `yearly` state that is never synced from the subscription (line 28).
